intended_object: The docstring says this is the witness that currying functors in four variables, (C₁ × C₂ × C₃ × C₄ ⥤ E) ⥤ (C₁ ⥤ C₂ ⥤ C₃ ⥤ C₄ ⥤ E), is a fully faithful functor.
explanation:
In the same file, `curry₄` is defined as the inverse of the equivalence `currying₄ : (C₁ ⥤ C₂ ⥤ C₃ ⥤ C₄ ⥤ E) ≌ C₁ × C₂ × C₃ × C₄ ⥤ E`. That equivalence is built by composing the ordinary currying equivalence with the associators of the product category.

Every equivalence of categories has a fully faithful inverse functor. The definition takes exactly that witness, `currying₄.fullyFaithfulInverse`, so it gives the claimed fully faithful structure on `curry₄`.

The categories are arbitrary, so the definition is stated in full generality. It follows the same pattern as the two- and three-variable versions (`fullyFaithfulCurry₃` and its relatives). It is a `FullyFaithful` structure, i.e. data witnessing a standard mathematical fact. It is not a mere implementation device, and it matches the docstring.
